scope_quote: Each registered operator shall operate a continuous monitoring system on every emission stack named in its permit; the system must be zero-checked and span-checked on a quarterly cycle. A calibration drift exceeding 2.5 percent of the span value must be corrected and logged within five working days; the correction record is countersigned by the monitoring technician. Quarterly summaries are transmitted to the authority no later than twenty days after the quarter closes.

locator_phrase: at least one duplicate sample at each monitoring well
scope_quote: Samples are collected from every monitoring well on the site schedule; each sampling event must include at least one duplicate sample at each monitoring well, submitted blind to the laboratory. Chain-of-custody forms are completed in ink at the time of sampling; corrections are initialled and dated. Laboratory results are reconciled against the previous four quarters before they are entered in the site register.

locator_phrase: signed manifests for a period of seven years
scope_quote: The generator retains signed manifests for a period of seven years from the date of shipment; manifests are stored in a secure facility with indexed retrieval. Each manifest must record the waste code, quantity, transporter registration and receiving facility permit number; corrections are made by a signed addendum. Duplicate manifests are provided to the transporter and to the receiving facility.

locator_phrase: independent verifier accredited by the authority
scope_quote: Offset verification is performed by an independent verifier accredited by the authority; the verifier may not hold a commercial interest in the offset project. The verification opinion must state whether the claimed reductions are additional, measurable and permanent; verified reduction certificates are issued only after the opinion is accepted. Records of verification are retained for the life of the offset plus ten years.

locator_phrase: report the 98th percentile over a rolling 24-hour window
scope_quote: Ambient air quality indices are computed for each monitoring station; the index is based on a rolling twelve-month dataset with completeness above seventy-five percent. Stations report the 98th percentile over a rolling 24-hour window; values are rounded to the nearest integer and published within ten days of the month end. Provisional values are flagged until the underlying data completes quality assurance.

locator_phrase: root-cause statement signed by the facility manager
scope_quote: A corrective action plan is raised for every finding of major non-conformance; the plan must name a responsible person and a completion date. The plan includes a root-cause statement signed by the facility manager; the statement identifies the process failure rather than the individual who performed the task. Closure evidence is filed within ninety days; extensions require written approval.
